cr_data.provenance: The artist [1887-1986]; her estate; bequest 1987 to NGA. (Source: NGA, 2025)
remarks_1999: Series renumbered by O'Keeffe and Doris Bry in 1970. Pictured in 1931 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 43. Reproduced and titled *Jack–in–the–Pulpit, Number 8* in *Magazine of Art *(September 1934); reproduced *untitled* in *New York World–Telegram* (March 1945). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A long, narrow form with a rounded tip that resembles the spadix of a jack-in-the-pulpit occupies the center of the frame. A white halo surrounds the black shape. Two bands of burgundy paint frame the long, narrow composition.
